definitions.explanation: A coiling, circular pattern or motion turning in toward a center, as in water swirling down a drain or a spiral shape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{渦巻|うずま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{渦巻|うずま}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This shell has a spiral shape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかって→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧{渦巻|うずま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っていた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The river water hit the rocks and was forming whirlpools.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{渦巻|うずま}く→渦巻く：13324_uzumaku⟧ (to swirl, to eddy), formed from ⟦{渦|うず}→渦：01859_uzu⟧ (eddy) + {巻|ま}き (winding). Used for both physical swirls of water or smoke and spiral shapes or patterns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渦巻|うずま}き⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: a spiral pattern
- {渦巻|うずま}き⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: spiral-shaped; in a spiral
- {渦巻|うずま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: form a swirl

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{渦|うず}→渦：01859_uzu⟧: eddy; swirl — the shorter, more general word; {渦巻|うずま}き emphasizes the coiling, winding shape
